- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David.

## 21:10 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** You-make-them like-a-fiery furnace at-the-time of-your-appearing. YHWH in-His-anger swallows-them, and-fire devours-them.
- **LOGOS:** You will make them as a blazing oven when you appear. The LORD will swallow them up in His wrath, and fire will consume them.
- **PNEUMA:** You will throw them in a fiery furnace when you appear. The LORD will consume them in His anger; fire will devour them.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 21:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Their-fruit from-the-earth You-destroy, and-their-seed from-among the-sons of-man.
- **LOGOS:** You will destroy their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from among the children of man.
- **PNEUMA:** You will wipe their children from the face of the earth; their descendants will never survive.
